# MNVR: Product & Code Documentation

> MNVR (Mobile Network Video Recorder) is an in-vehicle device for heavy vehicles such as buses. It records camera video for surveillance, tracks the vehicle's location, monitors vehicle health over the CAN bus, keeps a two-way TCP connection with a backend server, and supports voice calls. This file lists every documentation page; each link points to a plain Markdown file.

Base URL: https://primeedgeits.github.io/prime/ (all links below are relative to it, e.g. docs/overview.md is https://primeedgeits.github.io/prime/docs/overview.md).

How to use these docs (for AI assistants):

- Start with the Product Overview, then the Development Log for the latest state of work.
- Every page begins with a status: Idea (not agreed), Draft (being worked out), or Decided (agreed; build to this). Don't treat Idea or Draft content as final.
- TBD means unknown. Ask the user instead of guessing.
- Decisions and their reasons are in Decision Records.
- The hardware pages were written from the baseboard schematic. Anything marked "verify" was inferred from the drawing rather than printed on it.

## Product Documentation

- Features
  - [Video Surveillance](docs/product/features/video-surveillance.md): Multi-camera recording, storage, live view and playback
  - [GPS Tracking](docs/product/features/gps-tracking.md): Vehicle position reporting
  - [Vehicle Health (CAN)](docs/product/features/vehicle-health-can.md): Engine and vehicle data from the CAN bus
  - [Backend Communication (TCP)](docs/product/features/backend-tcp.md): Two-way link between device and backend
  - [Voice Calls](docs/product/features/voice-calls.md): Calls between the vehicle and the control room
- [System Architecture](docs/product/architecture.md): How the MPU board, baseboard, backend and dashboard fit together
- Hardware
  - [Hardware Overview](docs/product/hardware.md): Two-board design (MPU motherboard + baseboard) and what each board does
  - [MPU Motherboard](docs/hardware/mpu-board.md): The MC6630 application-processor board and its links to the baseboard
  - Baseboard V2.1
    - [Baseboard Overview](docs/hardware/baseboard/overview.md): Block diagram, main ICs, add-on boards, source schematic
    - [Power & Ignition](docs/hardware/baseboard/power.md): Power input, ignition sense and relay, voltage rails, battery monitoring
    - [MCU Pin Map (GD32F105)](docs/hardware/baseboard/mcu-pinmap.md): Every MCU pin, peripheral assignments, what firmware must handle
    - [Connectors](docs/hardware/baseboard/connectors.md): Every connector and its pinout
    - [Audio Paths](docs/hardware/baseboard/audio.md): Announcements, voice calls, microphone and speaker routing
    - [Communications](docs/hardware/baseboard/comms.md): USB hub, 4G modem, SIM/eSIM, GNSS, CAN, RS-485, RS-232, MPU-MCU UART
    - [Digital I/O & Sensors](docs/hardware/baseboard/digital-io.md): Isolated inputs/outputs, SOS, tamper, LEDs, accelerometer
    - [PCB & Fabrication](docs/hardware/baseboard/pcb.md): Layer stack, fabrication notes, mounting, test points
